notes: Jilan Rescue 1122 v1.0: Punjab emergency guide that works fully offline — giant tap-to-call Rescue 1122 card (fire, ambulance & rescue), other emergency numbers (Police 15, Fire Brigade 16, Edhi 115, Motorway Police 130, Child Helpline 1098, Women Helpline 1043, FIA Cybercrime 1991), when-to-call and what-to-say guides, plus the official Rescue Punjab website. This is an information guide by Jilan Apps Official; it is not affiliated with Rescue 1122 or any government body.
